summary: Morgan Stanley Capital I Inc., as depositor, disclosed in an 8-K that on August 31, 2026 it caused issuance of BANK5 2026-5YR24 Commercial Mortgage Pass-Through Certificates under an August 1, 2026 Pooling and Servicing Agreement with Trimont as master servicer, CWCapital as special servicer, Computershare as certificate administrator, Deutsche Bank as trustee, and Park Bridge as operating advisor. The 1351 Jerome Avenue mortgage loan is a pari passu companion piece of a whole loan whose A-1 lead note was securitized September 30, 2026 into BBCMS Mortgage Trust 2026-M1. This is a routine CMBS shelf takedown, not a special situation.
